Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (C/C077/C077n1710.xml). Dongshan Shouchu section of the Guzunxu Yulu. Dongshan Shouchu owns the retained deployment: asked what the golden-scaled fish is before it nudges its forehead over the dragon gate, he answers left eye half a catty, right eye eight ounces.

Occurrences.Kwic: 當晚小參，問答罷，師云：摩竭提國。乃拍禪床一下，云：親行此令，若是摩霄俊鶻，自合知時；其或尚留觀聽，沖上座不惜這一條窮性命子，將三百六十骨節、八萬四千毛竅盡情打開，颺在閙市叢中，左眼半斤、右眼八兩，在衲僧無星秤子上秤斤定兩，一點瞞諸人不得
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X70/X70n1376.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chijue Daochong. Chijue Daochong owns the retained deployment: evening small-assembly talk where the Chong senior seat spares not his poor life, flinging open every bone-joint and pore into the busy market with left eye half a catty and right eye eight ounces, weighed to the ounce on the patchwork monk's starless scale where nothing can cheat the assembly.

Senses.Explanation: The first half of 左眼半斤、右眼八兩: differently worded measures that come to equal weight, with neither addition nor subtraction permitted. An unnamed monk applies the half-jin/eight-liang appraisal to Dahui, who then expounds it. Guting Shanjian independently raises the same balanced formula in appraising Zhaozhou's dog case.
